licence_words: Roblox Terms of Use, Licensed Music: “Roblox may choose to make sound recordings and the musical works contained therein as well as sound effects (“Licensed Music”) available for Creator to use in Creator’s Experiences or other UGC. ... Roblox grants Creator (i) a non-exclusive, personal, limited, revocable, non-transferable license only to synchronize Licensed Music into an Experience or other UGC (“UGC With Licensed Music”), solely by and through the Services and only during the period when Roblox makes such Licensed Music available ... Creator is not required to provide attribution for Licensed Music ... Creator may only use Licensed Music on the Services. Creator agrees that it will not export, extract, download, or provide a way for anyone else to export, extract, or download the Licensed Music for use anywhere outside of the Services.” | DevForum (BitFist, 2022-03-09): “Audio that is owned and uploaded by Roblox or our music and SFX partners will remain public and usable by anyone in any experience.” and “All of the Roblox official licensed catalog of Music and SFX will remain Public and usable by developers in any of their experiences.” | Help Center ‘Using Licensed Music on Roblox’: “You can use up to 250 licensed tracks at a time in a single game on Roblox as part of the service.” “The Licensed Music can only be used on the Roblox platform and may not be downloaded.”
formats: Roblox audio asset by ID (rbxassetid://<id>), played through Sound or AudioPlayer; the source file is not exposed
style: Production library music in 261 genre tags (top: film-score 11,259; atmospheres; pop; classical; documentary; orchestral-hybrid; rock; ambient; hip-hop; contemporary-folk; corporate; jazz; children; funk; heavy-metal; edm; reggaeton) plus library stings, hits, whooshes and SFX.
human_made_evidence: Most tracks name a human composer in the artist field and an APM album; about 7% (72 of a 1,000-ID sample) name only the source library instead (e.g. 'KPM Main Series', 'Sonoton Music', 'Juice Music'), and only some 2018 items (56 of 323 sampled) carry a description such as 'Library: KPM Main Series'. Upload years of the 48,886 IDs in the file: 2018 15,085; 2022 3,185; 2023 1; 2025 25,429; 2026 5,186. No APM statement on generative AI was found; the 30,615 items uploaded in 2025-2026 carry composer credits but should be spot-checked before use.
bulk_download: No download: the licence forbids exporting, extracting or downloading. StudPilot may only hand over asset IDs that the user's own Studio loads. IDs enumerable without login via GET https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v2/assets:search?searchCategoryType=Audio&userId=<uploader>&query=<q>&maxPageSize=100&pageNumber=<0-9> (at most 1000 results per query, so the catalogue is crawled by many queries) and checked with GET https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v1/items/details?assetIds=<up to 100> (fiatProduct.published / purchasable). Open Cloud equivalent: POST /toolbox-service/v2/assets:search (scope creator-store-product:read; audioSearchFilters for audio).
free_tier_only_note: All counted items are $0 / isFree=true and published+purchasable on the Creator Store as of 2026-10-07; there is no paid tier for audio. Max 250 licensed tracks per game at a time.
note: item_count is an estimate of the published+purchasable+free APMOfficial audio, not the size of the ID file. The ID file holds 48,886 verified IDs (union of a 19,295-ID search crawl and the account's public inventory; items_by_category describes those 48,886: Music 42,377 -> 12; SoundEffect 4,781 and untyped 1,728 -> 11). Checker 2026-10-07: a fresh 45-query search (12,896 unique APM IDs, all published/purchasable/free) found the file covers about 100% of 2025-2026 uploads but only 8.6% of 2018 and 9.9% of 2022 uploads; scaling per year gives about 239,000 (a lower-side estimate, since both samples come from search). 21,131 inventory IDs are unpublished and ~33,900 return no Creator Store record; both excluded. Help Center states APM gives 'hundreds of thousands of tracks', consistent with the estimate.
